title: End-to-End Machine Learning Pipeline
tagline: A production-style MLOps pipeline that covers dataset experimentation, automated preprocessing, MLflow model training, CI retraining, Docker packaging, and observability with Prometheus and Grafana.
taglineId: Pipeline MLOps bergaya produksi yang mencakup eksperimentasi dataset, preprocessing otomatis, pelatihan model MLflow, CI retraining, packaging Docker, dan observability dengan Prometheus dan Grafana.
seoDescription: I built an end-to-end MLOps pipeline with preprocessing automation, MLflow training, CI retraining, Docker, and monitoring.
features: Completed the experimentation stage using the MSML experiment template, including dataset loading, exploratory data analysis, and manual preprocessing before automation.
Converted the notebook preprocessing flow into an automated Python preprocessing script that returns training-ready data and can be triggered through GitHub Actions.
Built the modelling stage with MLflow Tracking, hyperparameter tuning, manual metric logging, and additional artifacts stored through an online DagsHub tracking setup.
Created an MLflow Project based CI workflow that retrains the model automatically when the GitHub Actions trigger runs.
Extended the CI workflow to preserve model artifacts and build Docker images for Docker Hub using the MLflow Docker build flow.
Prepared local model serving and connected observability through Prometheus exporter metrics, Prometheus configuration, and Grafana dashboards.
Implemented advanced Grafana monitoring coverage with multiple system/model metrics and alerting rules for production-style model observation.
featuresId: Menyelesaikan tahap eksperimentasi menggunakan template eksperimen MSML, meliputi loading dataset, exploratory data analysis, dan preprocessing manual sebelum otomatisasi.
Mengubah alur preprocessing notebook menjadi skrip preprocessing Python otomatis yang mengembalikan data siap latih dan dapat dipicu melalui GitHub Actions.
Membangun tahap modelling dengan MLflow Tracking, hyperparameter tuning, pencatatan metrik manual, dan artifact tambahan yang disimpan melalui setup tracking online DagsHub.
Membuat alur kerja CI berbasis MLflow Project yang melatih ulang model secara otomatis saat trigger GitHub Actions berjalan.
Memperluas alur kerja CI untuk menyimpan artifact model dan membangun image Docker untuk Docker Hub menggunakan alur build Docker MLflow.
Menyiapkan model serving lokal dan menghubungkan observability melalui metrik Prometheus exporter, konfigurasi Prometheus, dan dashboard Grafana.
Mengimplementasikan cakupan monitoring Grafana tingkat lanjut dengan berbagai metrik sistem/model dan aturan alerting untuk observasi model bergaya produksi.
impact: Demonstrates an end-to-end MLOps workflow rather than only a standalone notebook or model training script.
Makes preprocessing and retraining repeatable through automation, reducing manual steps and improving project reproducibility.
Connects model development with CI, artifact management, containerization, monitoring, and alerting so the system is closer to real deployment practice.
Shows how model development can be operationalized with repeatable pipelines, tracked experiments, deployable artifacts, and observability.
impactId: Menunjukkan alur kerja MLOps end-to-end, bukan sekadar notebook atau skrip pelatihan model yang berdiri sendiri.
Membuat preprocessing dan retraining dapat diulang melalui otomatisasi, mengurangi langkah manual dan meningkatkan reproduktifitas proyek.
Menghubungkan pengembangan model dengan CI, manajemen artifact, containerization, monitoring, dan alerting sehingga sistem lebih mendekati praktik deployment nyata.
Menunjukkan bagaimana pengembangan model dapat dioperasionalkan dengan pipeline yang dapat diulang, eksperimen yang tercatat, artifact yang siap deploy, dan observability.

collaboration.label: Individual
contributions: Designed the full machine learning lifecycle from experimentation, automated preprocessing, model training, CI retraining, deployment preparation, and monitoring.
Built a production-style MLOps structure across experiment, modelling, MLflow project, and monitoring deliverables.
Prepared operational evidence and supporting files for MLflow, DagsHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, Prometheus, and Grafana workflows.
contributionsId: Merancang siklus hidup machine learning lengkap mulai dari eksperimentasi, preprocessing otomatis, pelatihan model, CI retraining, persiapan deployment, hingga monitoring.
Membangun struktur MLOps bergaya produksi mencakup eksperimen, modelling, proyek MLflow, dan deliverable monitoring.
Menyiapkan bukti operasional dan file pendukung untuk alur kerja MLflow, DagsHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, Prometheus, dan Grafana.

notes: Private production-style MLOps project covering automated preprocessing, MLflow + DagsHub tracking with tuning and artifacts, CI retraining with Docker image build, and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring with alerting.
notesId: Proyek MLOps privat bergaya produksi yang mencakup preprocessing otomatis, tracking MLflow + DagsHub dengan tuning dan artifact, CI retraining dengan build image Docker, serta monitoring Prometheus/Grafana dengan alerting.
